sections.markdown:
# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. Railroad warning-device text has an unqualified other-direction train phrase and an ambiguous stopped-vehicle list; do not infer that all trucks stop at every crossing or that a second train must come from a particular direction. No fixed train stopping distance is guaranteed. Current open-bed, headset, funeral, insurance and licensing provisions retain legal/currentness debt. Physical102 teen curfew omits some graduated-license distinctions elsewhere in the guide, so do not treat its short summary as a complete age/permit rule. Tint, three-front-occupant and detailed child-bicycle-seat thresholds need current exception review and are withheld. Telephone and program URLs are contact information, not driving-rule recall targets. Dated rail-crash totals remain unasserted. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.
